milestone: Wiki table controls, native selection and runnable source closure

observed: Four compact table controls above the table start
Header row is an actual checked checkbox control
Delete menu contains row, column and destructive table deletion
Deletion menu aligns with its trigger
referenceEvidence.limits: A later official navigation timed out; selected-text formatting is preserved locally without claiming verified official behavior.

actualFreeReuse.tableComposition: Official free c-checkbox-14/13 FieldLabel, Field and Checkbox composition, with existing registry Button, ButtonGroup and DropdownMenu implementations.
actualFreeReuse.checkbox: The real native Checkbox owns hit testing, keyboard focus and checked state; its fixed indicator is visually represented by an aria-hidden table icon.
actualFreeReuse.documentFrame: The existing Document editor uses ReUI Frame; this milestone does not claim Wiki newly uses Frame.
actualFreeReuse.correctedDuplicatePresentation: Wiki no longer uses the old generic Table actions popover for caret/cell table controls; its dedicated controls use the existing free component implementations.

customGap.reason: The installed free ReUI catalog does not supply a full Wiki document/table engine.
customGap.implementation: Existing native Tiptap TableKit, CellSelection, selection formatting and history; minimal composition and native can/selectedRect guards.
customGap.positioning: Native BubbleMenu virtual reference reads the real table. Wiki uses the documented updatePosition metadata after native options change.
customGap.menuPortal: The existing DropdownMenu exposes the native optional Portal container. Only Wiki opts into its actual toolbar to retain focus ancestry and the anchor.

behavior: Add real rows and columns, toggle header cells, delete rows, columns or the table, with independent native Undo.
Disable deletion of the final remaining row or column.
Retain real pointer CellSelection, Escape selection, document marks and history.
Preserve nonempty text selection Bold and link formatting.
Place the toolbar above the table start and keep native menus attached on desktop and phone.

localValidation.compatibilityLimit: Compatibility cases ran on the exact final shared DropdownMenu wrapper before the subsequent Wiki-only position refresh; not a new full-site rerun.
localValidation.browser: Browser plugin not available; existing Playwright workflow used. Official reference inspected separately through CUA.

originalDownload.dependencies: Existing physical normal-install APFS clones; not fresh installs

sourceTargets: Retains editor.tsx as default; adds the existing block-actions file to rich-text choices. All 18 template mappings, Account targets and unrelated block mappings are preserved.
remaining: Advanced editor kinds 3/4/5 and the full Wiki gutter/block-command fidelity remain separate work.
Wiki dedicated table controls omit the previous generic Merge/Split entries.
No backend collaboration or claim of complete official visual/interaction identity.
Final full CI and Pages deployment remain pending after this milestone is committed and pushed.
